requirement.applicantContext: IB applicants to the four-year indirect-entry Pharmacy (Honours) route in the 2026/2027 undergraduate prospectus; not the five-year school-leaver route.
requirement.subjectNotes: Higher Level Biology at least 4 AND Higher Level Chemistry at least 4, plus either Higher Level Mathematics OR Higher Level Physics at least 3. The named subjects and OR choice matter; this is not any three HL grades, and no particular Mathematics syllabus variant is specified.
requirement.conditions: For the 2026/2027 cycle, the prospectus's Pharmacy indirect-entry IB alternative requires passes in Chemistry, Biology and either Physics or Mathematics with the stated Higher Level grades. It publishes no overall IB total here. The diploma-credit, diploma-plus-experience and A-level routes are separate OR alternatives, so their employment/reference conditions are not added to every IB applicant. The named cycle and minima do not establish a current open window or a guaranteed place.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 18: Pharmacy indirect-entry IB alternative
source.evidence: Pharmacy indirect entry specifies HL Biology and Chemistry 4, with HL Mathematics or Physics 3.
